<description>
The chain_dir() method of test framework nodes returned the chain *name* for every non-signet chain, but mainnet stores its data in the top-level data directory. Mainnet tests worked around this by setting self.chain to the empty string, which doubles as the datadir name.

Instead of this workaround, we now set self.chain to "main" and map it to an empty datadir and config section key, so tests can name the chain the way the rest of the codebase does.

This was mentioned in https://github.com/bitcoin/bitcoin/pull/34566#discussion_r3667623302.
</description>
